message: My 2nd area of concern is regarding the Interpretation of AI-generated clauses...

author: @site36.official
message: AI-Generated Works Allowed with Labels --> You may create AI-generated music or vocal content using JoqniX’s likeness under the following guidelines… as stated... it can imply that...

author: @site36.official
message: This implies blanket permission to use JoqniX’s voice or likeness in AI content without controlled licensing or watermarking, which could mean...

author: @site36.official
message: Be interpreted as approval for voice cloning or deepfakes, especially if uploaded outside the fan community. Be used maliciously or deceptively on other platforms.

message: As a suggestion you can control the narrative by using this clause

author: @site36.official
message: "AI content is only permitted for personal, non-distributed fan expression. Training AI on JoqniX’s voice or using it to generate impersonated content remains prohibited unless explicitly licensed."

author: @site36.official
message: My 3rd Area of concern is regarding the clause that stated "You are welcome to monetize your JoqniX clips via YouTube, TikTok, etc."

author: @site36.official
message: The risk it carries is Fans might upload heavily edited content containing JoqniX’s voice, visuals, or music, then claim ad revenue, even though this technically uses copyrighted material.

author: @site36.official
message: Could open JoqniX up to Content ID abuse, especially with music that is later formally published.

author: @site36.official
message: So... to fix this, we can put out a Exclusivity clause to prevent such issues... (Once, they seek proper permission...and ONLY AFTER GETTING APPROVED O_O)

author: @site36.official
message: Clip monetization is allowed only for transformative edits. Use of full segments, unaltered audio, or musical content remains under copyright protection and may result in takedown or Content ID flags.
